download.description:
Native download attribute. Set it to an empty string to let the browser
choose the file name, or supply a suggested file name.

external.description:
Requests a new tab with noopener and adds an icon and an accessible
announcement. An explicit download still follows native download rules.

external-label.description: Localizable text appended to the accessible name in external mode.

href.description: Destination URL. Relative URLs and fragments use native anchor resolution.

rel.description: Space-separated native link relationships. External links always include noopener.

target.description: Native browsing-context name. External links use _blank.

underline.description:
Keep the underline in running text. Use hover for standalone navigation,
where placement identifies the link and keyboard focus still underlines it.

variant.description: Ink role. Primary uses accent ink and neutral uses body ink.

--ki-density-target-min.description: The smallest pointer target any density may produce: 24 x 24 CSS px by default and in compact (WCAG 2.5.8 AA), 44 x 44 in touch (WCAG 2.5.5). It floors a shrinking control but never lifts what a control paints: a control painted smaller extends its target to it, invisibly; rows and tabs grow to it (spec 045 A1).

--ki-focus-ring-color.description: Colour of the keyboard focus ring every focusable component draws: 3:1 or more against the page in every theme and scheme.

--ki-focus-ring-offset.description: Gap between a focusable component and its keyboard focus ring.

--ki-focus-ring-width.description: Thickness of the keyboard focus ring every focusable component draws (its outline). One token instead of one per component, so a mode or a theme changes every ring at once.

--ki-link-bg.description: Transparent backing for primary link text.

--ki-link-bg-image.description: Optional image overlay for link backing.

--ki-link-font-family.description: Body typeface used by link text.

--ki-link-icon-gap.description: Space between the label and the external link icon.

--ki-link-icon-size.description: External link icon edge relative to the inherited text size.

--ki-link-neutral-bg.description: Transparent backing for neutral link text.

--ki-link-radius.description: Corner radius used by the link focus outline.

--ki-link-underline-offset.description: Space between link text and its underline.

--ki-link-underline-thickness-hover.description: Underline thickness under a hover-capable pointer.

--ki-typography-visually-hidden-size.description: Nonzero edge for clipped text available to assistive technology.

component.description: A native navigation link with Kimen ink, underline, and focus styles.

link.description: The native anchor that renders the link and receives focus.
